purpose: Teach: 養育/全滅/大佐/私学/プロパガンダ/痴漢/偽善/処方箋

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、女性社員の養育支援を充実させろ
lines.en: Strengthen our company's childcare and family support benefits.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Each phrase lands with weight. No softening. The tone of someone accustomed to being obeyed. Direct eye contact implied.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。競合に全滅させられぬよう市場戦略を強化します
lines.en: Yes. We'll fortify our market strategy so competitors don't gain ground.
lines.style: Steady, businesslike. Crisp articulation of each commitment. Slight nod of acknowledgment at the opening. Competent, not defensive. The tone of someone who has thought this through.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、退役大佐の経験者を顧問に迎えろ
lines.en: Recruit a retired military officer as an advisor to the company.
lines.style: Same authoritative clip as the first line. Slightly more measured pause before 'officer'—a deliberate choice. No question mark in the voice, only directive weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。私学への寄付活動も継続しております
lines.en: Understood. We're continuing our donations to private educational institutions.
lines.style: Measured affirmation. Small breath before expanding into the second clause. Professional tone with underlying care for detail. Not rushed—each point gets its moment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、誤ったプロパガンダに踊らされるな
lines.en: Don't let this company be swayed by misinformation.
lines.style: Sharper edge here. The word 'misinformation' gets slight emphasis. Lean forward slightly in the cadence. Warning tone, not lecturing—paternal firmness from someone who has seen damage done.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員による痴漢行為は厳罰で対処します
lines.en: Yes. We handle sexual harassment by staff with strict penalties and no exceptions.
lines.style: No hesitation. Direct and clear. The severity comes through in evenness, not volume. Professional protocol read as commitment, not bureaucracy. Steady breath throughout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、偽善的なCSRには見えぬよう注意しろ
lines.en: Make sure our CSR efforts don't appear performative or hollow.
lines.style: Slight edge of critique here. 'Performative' carries a hint of skepticism. Slower pace than the directives—this is a warning about perception, not just action. Quiet intensity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員食堂で薬の処方箋管理も支援します
lines.en: Yes. We're also supporting prescription management assistance in the staff cafeteria.
lines.style: Final confirmation, slightly warmer in register. Acknowledges the fuller picture of employee care. Steady, conclusive. The last note lands with finality—a period, not a comma.
